startup_read_status.home_latest_continuity_gearbox: TARGETED_LOOKUP_NO_UNAMBIGUOUS_EXACT_PATH; continuity retained through fresh Active-8 exact pointer only; NO_BROAD_ARCHIVE_READ

agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review changes neither formal state nor executable code and does not claim C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only and must never become verified Experience.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current v2.1 and should remain observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
Credit weights 5/4/3 and operational 1 are engineering heuristics only, not calibrated capability units, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion truth.
Speed improvement remains NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED; commit count, heartbeat count, wake count, window age and awake time are invalid substitutes for paired performance evidence.

disagreements.finding: New material finding: select_gear checks standby before rollback_required, so when both authenticated terminal requests are true the function returns N and rollback R never forms. Current tests exercise standby and rollback separately but not the simultaneous conflict, so terminal authority precedence is currently incidental source order rather than an explicit safety contract.
disagreements.required_change: Define and test explicit rollback-vs-standby precedence before v2/v2.1 adoption. If rollback is the stronger recovery authority, R must dominate simultaneous standby; if another policy is intended, encode it as a versioned trusted terminal-conflict rule rather than branch order. Preserve the resolved terminal state across v1->v2->v2.1 and prevent secretary/pressure/anti-thrash from rewriting it.

disagreements.finding: v1 can return trusted R rollback or N standby, but v2 can overwrite surviving R/N with G1 through recovery_active, continuity-anchor failure or RED-secretary overlays.
disagreements.required_change: Authenticated terminal authority must have structural precedence over nonterminal telemetry; trusted R cannot be overwritten and N exit requires explicit trusted terminal-exit authority.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale secretary telemetry fresh, while secretary-derived numeric pressure fields can still affect routing after secretary_level is neutralized.
disagreements.required_change: Use replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope plus per-field provenance/freshness; stale/conflicting secretary-derived fields contribute zero routing pressure unless independently fresh and trusted.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed; permissive caller fallback must not substitute for fresh authority.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; lower shift count alone is not success.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from accepted evidence and tested against feedback-loop amplification.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events uses only a per-invocation seen set and str-coerced event_id. Same evidence can be replayed under new IDs or across restart/rollback, and rejected claims can reserve identity before acceptance.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed EventIdentity plus durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry. Exact accepted replay NO_OPs; same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; rejected claims do not reserve identity.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt. v2.1 can re-mint verified_experience_delta from raw event_kind plus event_independently_verified.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt; v2.1 may only project AcceptedExperienceReceipt and may not mint credit from raw caller fields.

disagreements.finding: Operational credit for DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND is granted from caller event_id/event_kind without durable artifact/defect acceptance proof, so operational totals and speed numerators can be inflated without verified Experience increasing.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe while keeping operational progress non-Experience.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup, and metric definitions must be frozen so baseline/candidate cannot differ in wake denominator, observation window, censoring, workload coverage or rework/rollback semantics.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one versioned canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical metric manifest and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.

statistical_risks: Simultaneous standby and rollback are currently resolved by branch order, so recovery/terminal-state statistics can be censored or misclassified depending on call shape rather than explicit authority policy.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Operational-progress counts without evidence receipts can inflate durable_progress_per_wake while verified Experience remains unchanged.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics require matched paired/crossover evaluation with a frozen versioned metric manifest and complete assigned-workload accounting.
proposed_tests: GB21-ROLLBACK-STANDBY-CONFLICT-231: standby=true and rollback_required=true simultaneously must resolve by an explicit precommitted terminal-authority rule; the result must not depend on source-code branch order.

GB21-ROLLBACK-STANDBY-CROSSPATH-232: the resolved simultaneous terminal state must remain identical across v1->v2->v2.1 and cannot be rewritten by secretary, pressure, recovery or anti-thrash overlays.

GB21-ROLLBACK-STANDBY-TELEMETRY-233: simultaneous terminal conflict with malformed/extreme nonessential telemetry must still reach the authenticated terminal conflict-resolution path or a stronger explicit terminal fail-closed state.
GB21-SECRETARY-FRESHNESS-FORGE-234: stale RED/ORANGE plus forged freshness=true and stale numeric pressure must not route without trusted per-field provenance/freshness binding.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-235: fresh authority=G1/recovery with permissive caller fallback must still produce the trusted authority result.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-SMALL-N-236: 1/1 and 2/3 samples must not trigger calibrated anti-thrash without precommitted minimum support; test entry/exit hysteresis around the threshold.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-PERF-NR-237: lower shift rate is rejected as improvement if cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency regresses.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-NULL-238: forged high verified_progress_density remains observational and cannot upshift or create credit.
GB21-EVENT-LINEAGE-REPLAY-239: same evidence under 10000 new IDs plus exact-ID restart/rollback replay produces one authoritative acceptance only.
GB21-VERIFIED-RECEIPT-BINDING-240: verified event without exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt yields zero authoritative verified Experience.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-RECEIPT-BINDING-241: raw DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND IDs without durable artifact/defect receipt yield zero authoritative operational credit.
GB21-CREDIT-NON-EQUIVALENCE-242: equal aggregate heuristic scores from different event mixtures are not equal capability or promotion evidence.

GB21-SPEED-PAIRED-BASELINE-243: sealed matched AB/BA or randomized crossover uses durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical versioned metric manifest and assigned-workload coverage.

blocks: claim that simultaneous rollback/standby authority is safely resolved
claim that terminal rollback/standby precedence is structurally preserved across v1->v2->v2.1
claim that secretary freshness or fresh-authority precedence is executable from current caller booleans
claim that anti-thrash is calibrated or performance-safe from current caller-supplied shift ratio
authoritative verified Experience accounting from current raw-field paths
authoritative operational-progress/speed numerator accounting from raw caller event fields
speedup or capability claims from raw credit totals, commits, wakes, heartbeat count, window age or uptime

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.
Rollback-vs-standby simultaneous conflict has an explicit versioned terminal-authority precedence rule and cross-layer tests; terminal outcome cannot depend on branch order.

Authenticated terminal rollback/standby precedence is structural across v1->v2->v2.1; trusted R cannot be overwritten by secretary/pressure/recovery overlays and N exit requires explicit trusted authority.
Secretary freshness and every secretary-derived routing field are provenance/freshness bound; stale/conflicting values have zero routing effect unless independently fresh and trusted.
authority_conflict projects the actual fresh AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fails closed.

recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and stateful hysteretic release; anti-thrash has paired performance non-regression evidence.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independently derived and shown non-self-reinforcing.
EventIdentity and evidence lineage are typed, durable and rollback-resistant; same evidence under new IDs or restart/rollback cannot regain credit.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier identity and immutable acceptance receipt; v2.1 cannot mint verified credit from raw caller fields.
DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only and authoritative operational credit requires evidence-bound receipt plus lineage dedupe.
Credit weights remain explicitly heuristic and are prohibited from capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance/promotion interpretation.

Any speedup claim uses a sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover baseline over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical metric manifest, assigned-workload accounting and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.
P_base remains read-only; heartbeat/poll/retry/window age/uptime remain zero Experience; Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step001-009 verified history remain preserved.
